sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Khamis Mushait' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT e.name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.id), 2) AS rate FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 10 ORDER BY rate DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT e.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2025-07', '2025-08', '2025-09') GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND c.segment = 'retail' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03')
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Ghamdi Logistics'

SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS order_month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered', 'returned') GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) LIMIT 1

SELECT cu.segment FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY cu.segment ORDER BY AVG(oi.quantity) DESC, cu.segment LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09', '10', '11', '12') GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS order_month FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered', 'returned') GROUP BY substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.id) DESC, substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) LIMIT 1

SELECT c.name FROM (SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY c.name) WHERE rn = 2
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Makkah')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Stationery' AND p.active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Asir')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' WHERE c.created_at < '2025-01-01' AND o.id IS NULL
SELECT unit_price FROM products WHERE sku = 'SKU-0012'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE priority = 'low' AND substr(opened_at, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06'

SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2025-04', '2025-05', '2025-06') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT ci.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('10', '11', '12') GROUP BY ci.id ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC, ci.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Household' AND p.active = 1
SELECT MAX(p.unit_price) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Bakery'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09')
SELECT ci.name FROM customers cu JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id WHERE cu.name = 'Mohammed Al-Ghamdi'

SELECT c.name FROM (SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') GROUP BY c.name) WHERE rn = 2

SELECT cu.segment FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2025-07', '2025-08', '2025-09') GROUP BY cu.segment ORDER BY AVG(oi.quantity) DESC, cu.segment LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tickets WHERE topic = 'billing' AND closed_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.method = 'wallet' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-03'
SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at))), 2) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'DHL' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2026')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Eastern Province' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' INTERSECT SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2026')

WITH avg_resolution AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg_resolution AS (SELECT c.id, AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24) AS avg FROM customers c JOIN support_tickets st ON st.customer_id = c.id WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(st.id) > 0) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ca.id) FROM cust_avg_resolution ca JOIN (SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 5) co ON co.id = ca.id WHERE ca.avg > (SELECT avg FROM avg_resolution)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cities WHERE region_id = (SELECT id FROM regions WHERE name = 'Qassim')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'

WITH revenue AS (SELECT ci.region_id, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS year, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06') GROUP BY ci.region_id, year) SELECT r1.name FROM regions r1 JOIN (SELECT region_id, (SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2025' THEN rev END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN rev END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2024' THEN rev END) AS growth FROM revenue GROUP BY region_id) r2 ON r1.id = r2.region_id ORDER BY growth ASC LIMIT 1

WITH avg_resolution AS (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_res FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), cust_avg_resolution AS (SELECT c.id, AVG((julianday(st.closed_at) - julianday(st.opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_res FROM customers c JOIN support_tickets st ON st.customer_id = c.id WHERE st.closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(st.id) > 0) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_avg_resolution car JOIN (SELECT c.id, COUNT(o.id) AS n FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 2) co ON car.id = co.id WHERE car.avg_res > (SELECT avg_res FROM avg_resolution)

SELECT c.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05', '06') GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, c.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'retail'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM payments WHERE method = 'card' AND substr(paid_at, 1, 7) LIKE '2024-10' OR substr(paid_at, 1, 7) LIKE '2024-11' OR substr(paid_at, 1, 7) LIKE '2024-12'
SELECT MAX(p.unit_price) AS max_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Snacks'
SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities c ON c.id = e.city_id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND c.name = 'Duba' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost), 2) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07', '08', '09') GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY margin DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT channel FROM (SELECT o.channel, AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) IN ('10', '11', '12') GROUP BY o.channel) ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 1

WITH revenue_2024 AS (SELECT r.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2024-01', '2024-02', '2024-03', '2024-04', '2024-05', '2024-06') GROUP BY r.id), revenue_2025 AS (SELECT r.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2025-01', '2025-02', '2025-03', '2025-04', '2025-05', '2025-06') GROUP BY r.id) SELECT r.name FROM revenue_2024 r24 JOIN revenue_2025 r25 ON r24.id = r25.id JOIN regions r ON r.id = r24.id ORDER BY ((r25.revenue - r24.revenue) * 1.0 / r24.revenue) DESC, r.name LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise'
